Name: Collector
Author: rokugin
Description:
[size=3]The Collector is a new big craftable that collects various configurable items from the map it's placed on. All Collectors store in one shared inventory that can be accessed from any Collector.

Visually, the storage space of the Collector is the same size as a Big Chest, however the actual capacity is unlimited. Items collected beyond
the visual limit are still stored, you just have to pull items out in
order to access the excess.

[/size][size=4]Currently supports collecting:[/size][size=3]
[spoiler]Animal produce
Crops
Flowers
Forage
Spawned objects (gems, minerals, etc)
Spring Onions
Ginger
Tree forage
Moss
Fruit trees
Artifact spots
Seed spots
Mushroom boxes
Garbage cans
Berry bushes
Tea bushes
Panning spots
Secret Woods stumps
Slime Balls
Garden pots
Crab pots[/spoiler]
If there's anything that's not covered, feel free to leave a suggestion in the comments and I'll consider it for a future update.
[/size][size=4]
Unlocking the recipe:[/size][size=3]
This mod currently adds a special order and two events revolving around the recipe.
In order to start the quest to get the recipe you need at least 2 hearts with Maru and Farming level 10.
If you're married to Maru you'll get an event on the Farm after reaching Farming 10, otherwise you'll receive a letter a day or so after reaching Farming 10 and 2 hearts with Maru.
The events and special order can be disabled in the settings in order to unlock access to the recipe immediately.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/TMNC1K7/install.png[/img]
1. Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].
2. Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
3. Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
4. Run the game using SMAPI.
[i](Optionally) [/i]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31247]Perfection Exclusions[/url] to keep the Grabber-Collector swap recipes from counting towards perfection.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/kMncK1j/compatibility.png[/img]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Should work with any expansions and most* other mods, depending on what kind of items they're spawning.[/size]
[*][size=3]Multiplayer should work[/size]
[/list][size=3]Let me know if there's any issues and I'll try to address them.

* Automate does not pull items from the Collector's because they're not chests or machines. I will look at what it takes to add support for Automate but it most likely will be a while.
